source.title: Open problems, why and how or: conjecture, did you say conjecture?

trace.notes: Input normalized as zbMATH Open document 7315536. Local indexed source data for the same URL identified the title as "Open problems, why and how or: conjecture, did you say conjecture?" and year 2020. This local index was used only as resolver metadata, not as technical source text.

Failure mode: network_or_dns_failure and metadata_only. Direct web fetch of https://zbmath.org/7315536 returned a cache-miss failure. Local curl attempts to the zbMATH REST API failed because the sandboxed environment could not resolve or connect to api.zbmath.org. The API terms page and public documentation were reachable only as metadata/documentation, not as the requested record or full text.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the zbMATH identifier and exact-title searches including "Open problems, why and how or: conjecture, did you say conjecture?", "Open problems, why and how", and "conjecture, did you say conjecture" plus PDF/OpenAlex/DOI variants. Search results did not expose a readable PDF or full HTML source confirming the same exact title; inspected candidates were unrelated pages, general pages about conjectures/open problems, metadata pages, or pages lacking the target title.

No questions were extracted because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source exposing the technical problem statements was recovered. The accessible evidence was resolver metadata, local index metadata, search snippets, or unrelated pages, which are inadequate technical sources under the source adequacy gate.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/7315536.json and outputs/latest.json.
